The Lexco non-maintained emergency LED twin spotlight provides reliable illumination during power outages. This 3W, 450 lumen unit features integrated LED technology and a 3-hour emergency backup, making it suitable for commercial and industrial environments such as warehouses, workshops, and corridors. Its robust polycarbonate body is IP65 rated, offering waterproof and UV-resistant protection for both indoor and outdoor installations. The adjustable twin lights allow for precise beam direction, and multiple cable entry points simplify installation. Fixings and fittings are supplied for convenience.
